review_candidates.description: At SyncVR Medical, we build immersive technology for places where it truly matters. Our XR platform is used in hospitals across Europe to support patients during care and to help healthcare professionals work more effectively. By combining medical insight with cutting-edge immersive technology, we create solutions that are practical, scalable, and clinically meaningful. As a growing medtech scale-up, we are continuously expanding how XR can be applied in healthcare, from patient-focused experiences to new solutions that support training, education, and professional development. With a strong presence in 6 countries, SyncVR Medical is shaping the future of immersive technology in healthcare. Tasks As an XR Developer within our Education project team, you are responsible for the technical realization of state-of-the-art medical simulations. You will work in a high-performance environment alongside top-tier 3D artists and medical experts to build scalable, AI-enhanced training modules. Your daily technical tasks: Unity Development: Write clean, modular C# code to build interactive medical procedures, ensuring systems are flexible enough to be reused across dozens of different surgical and anesthetic modules. Art-to-Engine Integration: Work hand-in-hand with our 3D artists to bridge the gap between high-fidelity assets and engine performance. You’ll be the "engine-master" who ensures the lighting, shaders, and assets look incredible while maintaining a steady FPS on standalone headsets (Quest 3). AI Implementation: Proactively research and integrate AI tools to speed up development workflows and create dynamic, non-linear training scenarios. Clinical Logic Programming: Translate complex medical protocols into robust state-machine logic, ensuring virtual medical equipment and patient reactions behave exactly as they would in a real Operating Room. Data & Interoperability: Implement standards such as xAPI telemetry to track student progress and ensure the modules communicate seamlessly with centralized digital infrastructures and Learning Management Systems (LRS). Requirements Hands-on 3D Development: You have 2–5 years of professional experience building real-time Unity applications and environments, taking ownership from concept through delivery. Advanced Unity Expertise: You are highly proficient in Unity and feel confident shipping features, improving existing systems, and solving complex technical challenges. Production Team Experience: You have worked in game studios, XR agencies, or industrial simulation companies, and understand what it takes to deliver real-world 3D projects. Bonus: Simulation-Driven Work: You have experience creating digital training, serious games, or simulation-based projects where accuracy, usability, and performance are critical. Benefits Build for Impact: Your work will power XR simulations that actually improve patient care and train healthcare professionals. What you create matters. Grow Fast: This is a launchpad: grow your skills, take on responsibility, and accelerate toward senior or leadership roles. Be Part of Something Meaningful: Join a fast-moving medtech scale-up with real adoption in hospitals across Europe and a mission you can be proud of. Ready the change healthcare education forever?

About The Role We are seeking a Investor Relations Manager to join VentureOne and support fundraising, investment activities, and strategic transactions across VentureOne and its portfolio companies. The role will work closely with leadership teams and investors to support capital raising, assess investment opportunities, execute transactions, and build long-term relationships with the global investment community. The ideal candidate will have experience in investment banking, venture capital, private equity, corporate development, or fundraising, with strong financial, commercial, and transaction execution capabilities. Key Responsibilities Fundraising: Support and manage fundraising processes for VentureOne portfolio companies, from investor targeting and outreach through due diligence, term sheet negotiation and closing. Investment Analysis: Evaluate new investment and venture opportunities through financial, commercial, strategic, and market analysis. Financial Modelling & Valuation: Build and review financial models, conduct valuation analysis, and develop financing scenarios and investor return scenarios. Transaction Execution: Support investment and financing transactions, including due diligence, transaction structuring, term sheet negotiations, and coordination with legal, finance, management teams, and external advisors. Investor Pipeline Management: Develop and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective investors and track engagement, feedback, investment appetite, and next steps throughout fundraising processes. Market & Investor Research: Identify relevant investors, comparable transactions, valuation benchmarks, market trends, and financing activity across VentureOne's priority sectors. Investment Presentations: Prepare investment recommendations, transaction analyses, and strategic materials for senior management. Strategic Projects: Support selected M&A, joint venture, partnership, and other strategic investment opportunities across VentureOne and its portfolio. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field. Strong financial modelling, valuation, and analytical capabilities. Preferred Qualifications At least 8 years of relevant experience in investment banking, venture capital, private equity, growth equity, corporate development, transaction advisory, or a similar investment-focused role. Demonstrated experience supporting or executing fundraising, investment, M&A, or other corporate transactions. review_candidates.description: The Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) is a global partnership to make palm oil sustainable. Today, the RSPO is a global, non-profit organisation with over 6,000 voluntary members across 104 countries and territories, representing every link in the supply chain: oil palm producers, palm oil processors and traders, consumer goods manufacturers, retailers, banks and investors, environmental or nature conservation non-governmental organisations (NGOs), and social or developmental NGOs. At RSPO, we believe that our success is built by the passion, dedication, skills, and expertise of our people. They are the ones who drive our organisation to new heights and guide us through the next phase of our development. The Manager, Innovation & Transformation plays a key role in translating RSPO’s strategic ambitions into executional reality. This role is built around three fundamental, ongoing responsibilities: reviewing RSPO’s end-to-end processes and systems to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement that strengthens member experience and internal efficiency and productivity; running the PMO function, providing the governance and tracking discipline needed to keep the organization’s strategic initiatives on course; and leading the change management needed to drive adoption of the systems and process improvements delivered, ensuring they translate into lasting impact. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, the role helps embed a disciplined, transparent way of managing change and progress, enabling RSPO to translate strategy into consistent, measurable outcomes as it continuously improves how it works. The specific initiatives this role leads will evolve as RSPO’s priorities evolve. The immediate priority is the reassessment, redesign and rebuild of RSPO’s Salesforce system, in support of the 3-Year Operating Plan’s target outcomes such as faster membership-to-certification timelines and improved member advocacy. The location of this role is Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Duties include but will not be limited to the following: Project Delivery (Business Analysis & Project Management) Assess as-is member journey processes, such as lead generation, membership application, certification and post-membership support, and identify opportunities to optimise these processes ahead of implementation. Identify automation and AI capabilities to improve the efficiency of current member journeys, and embed these into functional requirements and implementation. Building on member journey findings, gather, document and validate business requirements from stakeholders across RSPO for system implementations Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories and process flows for the vendor/development team. Manage end-to-end project plan, including scope, timeline, resourcing and dependencies. Act as the primary liaison with the vendor, coordinating requirement walkthroughs, sprint reviews and go-live activities. Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT), ensuring solutions meet business requirements before deployment. Support change management and training activities to drive user adoption of the new system. Identify gaps or trade-offs between business needs and technical design, and escalate decisions to relevant stakeholders as needed. Build strong working relationships with internal IT/digital teams and Business Process Owners (BPOs) to support project delivery. Project Management Office (PMO) Track progress of the organisation’s strategic initiatives ensuring execution stays aligned with defined target outcomes. Maintain a consolidated tracker of key initiatives, risks, issues and dependencies across divisions. Run governance cadences (e.g. status reviews, steering updates) to keep initiatives on track. Proactively identify risks and issues, and escalate to relevant stakeholders/leadership with recommended mitigations. Support project sponsors and initiative owners with project management tools, templates and best practices. Prepare periodic reporting on organisation-wide initiative status for leadership. Change Management & Culture Transformation Lead change management activities that drive adoption of new systems, tools and processes introduced through assigned projects. Design and execute communication and engagement materials to support project rollouts and stakeholder buy-in. Help promote a culture of structured execution, accountability and continuous improvement across the organisation. Act as a champion for consistent project management and governance practices among project teams and stakeholders. THE SUCCESSFUL APPLICANT Education Preferably Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field. Experience 5 – 8 years of experience in business analysis and/or project management, with CRM (Salesforce or similar) implementation projects and operations execution, covering sales to servicing modules and processes. Experience with SDLC and Agile project implementation methodologies. Lean Six Sigma certification. Experience working with external vendors/implementation partners on requirement gathering and solution delivery. Experience running a PMO function, tracking multiple concurrent initiatives. Familiar with business analysis and analytics techniques (process mapping, user story writing, data modelling), including data warehouse or data lake experience. Experience with change management and communications practices to support user adoption. Exposure to human-centred design or design thinking methodologies to develop member-centric solutions. Familiar with using AI tools and solutions (e.g. GenAI assistants, automation platforms) to drive productivity. ESSENTIAL SKILLS Business Analysis & Requirements Management Project & Program Management Vendor Management Governance & Risk/Issue Tracking Stakeholder Management & Collaboration Analytical & Problem-Solving Thinking Change Management Member-Centric Orientation Human-Centric Design & Design Thinking Digital-First Mindset AI Fluency & Productivity Tools HOW TO APPLY Qualified applicants are invited to send in their updated CV giving comprehensive details of educational background, work experience, and related achievements to careers@rspo.org. Please state “Job Application – Manager, Innovation & Transformation” in your email subject line. **RSPO is an equal opportunity employer. Due to the volume of applications received, only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

review_candidates.title: Junior Embedded Engineer - Aerospace
review_candidates.description: Ruolo : Junior Emdedded Engineer Sede: Torino.. ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Nato più di 30 anni fa e presente in 30 Paesi, il Gruppo ALTEN si è affermato come leader mondiale nell’ingegneria e nei Servizi IT e leader Europeo per la consulenza nell'industria Life Sciences. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari. Di cosa ti occuperai: In un’ottica di rafforzamento del team Engineering, dopo un iniziale periodo di affiancamento, potrai iniziare il tuo percorso professionale su diversi progetti in ambito Aerospace & Defence. Le risorse saranno coinvolte in attività legate a: Sviluppo Software; Sviluppo e progettazione di sistemi di controllo/implementazione di algoritmi di controllo; Verifica e Validazione. Requisiti: Laurea Specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Meccatronica, Aeronautica, Elettronica o percorsi affini; Conoscenza dei linguaggi di programmazione C, C++, Python; Conoscenza di Matlab, Simulink, Labview; Sistemi CAD: Autocad, Solidworks, Catia, Creo, SolidEdge; Attitudine al lavoro di gruppo e al problem solving; Buona capacità di analisi e organizzazione. Salary range: La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 27.000 EUR e 30.000 EUR. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. "Il ruolo include l’applicazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni e il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Prevede la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, il riconoscimento di minacce come il phishing e la segnalazione di eventuali incidenti. È prevista formazione per supportare queste attività." Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazionee, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più ampi. Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99. I prossimi step Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarlo attentamente. Se sarà in linea con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, il nostro team Talent Acquisition ti contatterà telefonicamente. L’iter di selezione proseguirà con un colloquio conoscitivo con l'area Business, un successivo colloquio più approfondito, durante il quale potrebbe essere richiesto un test pratico, ed infine un colloquio tecnico. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di selezione. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro gestionale per poterlo rivalutare per opportunità future. Operando in 13 diverse città e altrettanti settori, potrebbero contattarti più Talent Acquisition Partner e/o più Business Manager, se riterranno che il tuo profilo sia in linea con i progetti e le necessità che stanno ricercando in quel momento. Se dovessi identificare ulteriori offerte di tuo interesse e in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente. ALTEN opera nel rispetto dei principi di diversità, equità ed inclusione, che alimentano i nostri valori. ALTEN ha l’obiettivo di abbattere ogni barriera e pregiudizio, garantendo un ambiente di lavoro accessibile ed accogliente, valutando candidature indipendentemente da genere, etnia, disabilità (artt. 1 e 18, legge 68/99), età, orientamento sessuale, religione, stato civile, convinzioni personali e politiche, appartenenza ad organizzazioni sindacali, responsabilità familiari e back-ground socio-economico.

As Head of Karting, you will lead the FIA's global Karting strategy, oversee the administration of the Commission Internationale de Karting (CIK), and manage the FIA Karting Championships. Working closely with the CIK President, FIA leadership, ASNs, organisers, service providers, teams, and competitors, you will drive initiatives that strengthen participation, inclusion, sustainability, and sporting excellence across the discipline. Based in Geneva within the Circuit Sport Department, you will lead a multidisciplinary team and contribute directly to the development of one of motorsport's most important pathways to professional racing. You will report directly to the Head of Mass Participation Disciplines & Activities. MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic development of Karting and participation growth Define and implement the FIA Karting strategy in collaboration with the CIK President, the Head of Mass Participation Disciplines & Activities and FIA Management. Lead initiatives aimed at growing participation at all levels of Karting, supporting programmes such as Inclusive Karting, the Global Karting Plan and Global Kart. Promote grassroots and Arrive & Drive activities through collaboration with ASNs and FIA stakeholders. Oversee the continued deployment of the International Karting Ranking (IKR), support National Karting Rankings (NKR) initiatives and coordinate the FIA Karting Shootout. Drive sustainability, inclusion and development projects that strengthen the global Karting ecosystem. Administration of the Commission Internationale de Karting (CIK) Lead the administration of the Commission Internationale de Karting (CIK), including the coordination of meetings, working groups and regulatory activities. Oversee the preparation of proposals, reports and documentation for FIA governing bodies and leadership. Supervise the update, publication and implementation of FIA Karting regulations and related communications. Act as the FIA's principal liaison with ASNs, Karting stakeholders and partner organisations worldwide. Administrative and regulatory management of the FIA Karting Championships (including KEC and Shootout) Oversee the planning, budgeting and regulatory management of FIA Karting Championships and related events. Manage relationships with Championship Service Providers, organisers, officials, suppliers, teams and competitors. Supervise tender processes, contractual matters and operational performance of external partners. Support the continuous improvement, attractiveness and long-term development of FIA Karting Championships. Karting Team Management Lead, develop and support the Karting team, ensuring clear objectives, effective collaboration and high-quality delivery. Manage departmental budgets, resources and operational planning. Promote efficient working methods and cross-functional collaboration with FIA departments, including Technical Operations & R&D, Safety & Medical, Commercial, Communications, Digital Technology and Regulatory & Governance. PROFILE: University degree in Business, Engineering, Sports Management or a related field. 10 to 15 years of professional experience in motorsport, with significant exposure to Karting and/or Single-Seater disciplines. Experience within a sporting federation, ASN, championship organiser, promoter or manufacturer would be an asset. Strong knowledge of the international Karting ecosystem and its key stakeholders. Proven experience in a leadership role and in managing complex stakeholder environments. Strong understanding of sporting regulations, championship operations and governance processes. Strategic mindset combined with strong organisational and problem-solving skills. Fluent English is required. Additional languages are considered an advantage. Ability to work under pressure while maintaining a high level of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality. Willingness to be based in Geneva and to travel internationally on a regular basis. If you are interested, please send us your application in pdf! Deadline to Apply: September 30th, 2026 The FIA is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.
